AI.title_translation: 一种改进的双注意力Transformer-LSTM用于微半球谐振器设计中的小样本模态频率和实际锚点半径预测
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种改进的双注意力Transformer-LSTM模型，用于快速准确地预测微半球谐振器（MHR）的模态频率和实际锚点半径，在小样本数据下实现了高精度（96.35%），并将计算时间缩短至传统有限元方法的1/48,000。
AI.motivation: 微半球谐振器（MHR）的设计需要对多种可能的配置进行全面评估，并且关键参数组合的仿真极其耗时（特别是考虑到高温导致的锚点变形）。因此，需要一种快速预测模态频率和实际锚点半径的方法来实现快速设计定型。
AI.method: 通过改变谐振器高度、锚点半径和边缘厚度等关键参数，进行有限元吹玻璃仿真和模态分析以获取数据。提出了一种改进的Transformer-LSTM模型，用双多头自注意力（MHSA）机制取代了Transformer的标准前馈网络，以增强对隐藏信息的捕获，解决小样本回归预测的挑战。通过消融实验和对比实验验证了方法的优越性。
AI.result: 设计优化实验证明，预测精度达到96.35%。计算时间缩短至传统有限元方法的1/48,000。该方法被验证为MHR设计的有效支持，并为复杂工艺条件下的智能MEMS器件设计提供了新范例。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出的改进双注意力Transformer-LSTM模型，在小样本数据下实现了微半球谐振器模态频率和实际锚点半径的快速、高精度预测（96.35%），显著提高了设计效率，并为复杂工艺下的智能MEMS器件设计提供了新的范例。
AI.translation: 高温吹玻璃制造的微半球谐振器（MHR）具有高对称性和高Q值，适用于精密惯性导航。然而，MHR设计需要对多种可能的配置进行全面评估，并且要求对关键参数组合进行极其耗时的仿真。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了一种使用改进的Transformer-LSTM（长短期记忆）模型的快速预测方法，用于对所设计的MHR的模态频率和实际锚点半径进行快速设计定型。高温导致的锚点软化变形会使实际锚点半径小于设计值。通过改变谐振器高度、锚点半径和边缘厚度等关键参数，进行了有限元吹玻璃仿真和模态分析，以获得前六个模态频率和实际锚点半径。为了解决有限数据下的回归预测挑战，双多头自注意力（MHSA）机制取代了Transformer的标准前馈网络，以提高隐藏信息的捕获能力，从而实现模态频率和锚点半径的高精度预测。通过检查锚点半径的可制造性并允许快速、无干扰的模态特性评估，消融实验和对比实验验证了该方法的优越性，为MHR设计提供了有效的支持。设计优化实验表明，预测精度达到96.35%，计算时间缩短至传统有限元方法的1/48,000，显著提高了设计效率。这项研究为复杂工艺条件下的智能微机电系统（MEMS）器件设计提供了一种新的范式。
AI.summary: 本文旨在解决精密导航中微半球谐振器（MHR）设计中耗时的仿真挑战。为此，提出了一种改进的双注意力Transformer-LSTM模型，用于在小样本数据下快速预测模态频率和实际锚点半径（受高温制造影响的关键参数）。该改进方案用双多头自注意力机制取代了标准的Transformer前馈网络，以增强信息捕获。实验结果显示，该模型达到了96.35%的预测精度，并将计算时间缩短至传统有限元方法的1/48,000，为高效、智能的MEMS器件设计提供了新的范式。
AI.keywords: 双注意力Transformer-LSTM, 小样本预测, 微半球谐振器, 模态频率, 锚点半径
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将Transformer架构（通过引入双MHSA取代FFN）改进并应用于复杂工程领域（MEMS设计中的工艺变异）的小样本回归预测。其重要性在于实现了巨大的实用价值，将设计迭代时间缩短了48,000倍，这对加速高精度惯性传感器的开发周期至关重要。该研究成功地弥合了复杂物理仿真（有限元法）与快速AI驱动设计优化之间的差距，特别是解决了实际制造过程中工艺导致的变形（实际与设计锚点半径的差异）问题。

title: FAQNAS: FLOPs-aware Hybrid Quantum Neural Architecture Search using Genetic Algorithm
summary: Hybrid Quantum Neural Networks (HQNNs), which combine parameterized quantum circuits with classical neural layers, are emerging as promising models in the noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) era. While quantum circuits are not naturally measured in floating point operations (FLOPs), most HQNNs (in NISQ era) are still trained on classical simulators where FLOPs directly dictate runtime and scalability. Hence, FLOPs represent a practical and viable metric to measure the computational complexity of HQNNs. In this work, we introduce FAQNAS, a FLOPs-aware neural architecture search (NAS) framework that formulates HQNN design as a multi-objective optimization problem balancing accuracy and FLOPs. Unlike traditional approaches, FAQNAS explicitly incorporates FLOPs into the optimization objective, enabling the discovery of architectures that achieve strong performance while minimizing computational cost. Experiments on five benchmark datasets (MNIST, Digits, Wine, Breast Cancer, and Iris) show that quantum FLOPs dominate accuracy improvements, while classical FLOPs remain largely fixed. Pareto-optimal solutions reveal that competitive accuracy can often be achieved with significantly reduced computational cost compared to FLOPs-agnostic baselines. Our results establish FLOPs-awareness as a practical criterion for HQNN design in the NISQ era and as a scalable principle for future HQNN systems.

AI.title_translation: FAQNAS：使用遗传算法的FLOPs感知混合量子神经架构搜索
AI.tldr: 我们提出了FAQNAS，这是一个使用遗传算法的混合量子神经网络（HQNN）架构搜索框架，它将准确性和计算量（FLOPs）纳入多目标优化，以在保持高性能的同时显著降低HQNN在经典模拟器上的运行成本。
AI.motivation: 在噪声中级量子（NISQ）时代，混合量子神经网络（HQNNs）很有前景。由于HQNNs主要在经典模拟器上训练，浮点运算（FLOPs）直接决定了运行时间和可扩展性。因此，需要一个将FLOPs作为核心指标来优化HQNN设计的框架，以解决计算成本问题。
AI.method: 引入了FAQNAS，这是一个FLOPs感知的神经架构搜索（NAS）框架。该框架将HQNN设计建模为一个多目标优化问题，旨在平衡准确性和FLOPs。它明确地将FLOPs纳入优化目标中，并使用遗传算法（根据标题）进行搜索。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集上进行的实验表明，量子FLOPs在准确性提升中占主导地位，而经典FLOPs基本保持不变。帕累托最优解揭示，与不考虑FLOPs的基线相比，FAQNAS能以显著降低的计算成本实现具有竞争力的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果确立了FLOPs感知是NISQ时代混合量子神经网络（HQNN）设计的一个实用标准，也是未来HQNN系统的一个可扩展原则。
AI.translation: 混合量子神经网络（HQNNs）结合了参数化量子电路和经典神经层，正在成为噪声中级量子（NISQ）时代有前景的模型。虽然量子电路本身不以浮点运算（FLOPs）来衡量，但在NISQ时代，大多数HQNN仍需要在经典模拟器上训练，而FLOPs直接决定了其运行时间和可扩展性。因此，FLOPs代表了一种衡量HQNN计算复杂度的实用且可行指标。在这项工作中，我们引入了FAQNAS，这是一个FLOPs感知的神经架构搜索（NAS）框架，它将HQNN设计公式化为一个平衡准确性和FLOPs的多目标优化问题。与传统方法不同，FAQNAS明确地将FLOPs纳入优化目标，从而能够发现既能实现强大性能又能最小化计算成本的架构。在五个基准数据集（MNIST、Digits、Wine、Breast Cancer和Iris）上的实验表明，量子FLOPs主导了准确性的提升，而经典FLOPs基本保持不变。帕累托最优解揭示，与不考虑FLOPs的基线相比，通常可以用显著降低的计算成本实现具有竞争力的准确性。我们的结果确立了FLOPs感知是NISQ时代HQNN设计的一个实用标准，也是未来HQNN系统的一个可扩展原则。
AI.summary: 本文提出了FAQNAS，一种针对混合量子神经网络（HQNNs）的FLOPs感知神经架构搜索框架。鉴于NISQ时代的HQNNs在经典模拟器上运行时FLOPs是衡量计算成本的关键指标，FAQNAS将架构搜索视为一个平衡准确性和FLOPs的多目标优化问题。实验证明，该方法生成的帕累托最优架构在保持高准确性的同时，显著降低了计算成本，证实了FLOPs感知在HQNN设计中的实用性和重要性。
AI.keywords: 混合量子神经网络, 神经架构搜索, FLOPs感知, 遗传算法, 多目标优化
AI.comments: 该工作的创新点在于将经典计算领域常用的效率指标——FLOPs——明确地引入到混合量子/经典模型的架构搜索中，特别是考虑到NISQ时代对经典模拟器的依赖。这使得HQNN的设计从单纯追求准确性转向了实用性和可扩展性的平衡。通过将FLOPs纳入优化目标，该框架解决了HQNN在经典模拟器上训练时面临的实际瓶颈（运行时间和资源消耗）。这为设计更高效、更具可扩展性的HQNN系统提供了实际的指导原则，对于推动量子机器学习在当前技术条件下的应用具有重要意义。然而，该方法主要关注经典模拟器上的FLOPs，未解决在真实量子硬件上运行时（如门深度或量子测量次数）的实际量子资源消耗问题。

title: Black-Box On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models
summary: Black-box distillation creates student large language models (LLMs) by learning from a proprietary teacher model's text outputs alone, without access to its internal logits or parameters. In this work, we introduce Generative Adversarial Distillation (GAD), which enables on-policy and black-box distillation. GAD frames the student LLM as a generator and trains a discriminator to distinguish its responses from the teacher LLM's, creating a minimax game. The discriminator acts as an on-policy reward model that co-evolves with the student, providing stable, adaptive feedback. Experimental results show that GAD consistently surpasses the commonly used sequence-level knowledge distillation. In particular, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct (student) trained with GAD becomes comparable to its teacher, GPT-5-Chat, on the LMSYS-Chat automatic evaluation. The results establish GAD as a promising and effective paradigm for black-box LLM distillation.

AI.title_translation: 大语言模型的黑盒在策略蒸馏
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为生成对抗蒸馏（GAD）的黑盒在策略蒸馏方法，通过一个生成器（学生模型）和判别器（自适应奖励模型）的极小极大博弈来训练学生模型，效果显著优于传统方法，使学生模型性能接近其专有教师模型。
AI.motivation: 在仅能访问专有教师模型文本输出（黑盒设置）的情况下，创建学生大语言模型，并引入一种能够实现黑盒在策略蒸馏的方法。
AI.method: 采用生成对抗蒸馏（GAD）。将学生LLM视为生成器，训练一个判别器来区分学生和教师LLM的响应，形成极小极大博弈。判别器充当与学生模型共同演化的在策略、稳定且自适应的奖励模型。
AI.result: GAD持续优于常用的序列级知识蒸馏方法。特别是，使用GAD训练的Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct（学生模型）在LMSYS-Chat自动评估中与教师模型GPT-5-Chat相当。
AI.conclusion: GAD被确立为一种有前景且有效的黑盒LLM蒸馏范式。
AI.translation: 黑盒蒸馏通过仅学习专有教师模型的文本输出来创建学生大语言模型（LLMs），而无需访问其内部逻辑值或参数。在这项工作中，我们引入了生成对抗蒸馏（GAD），它实现了在策略和黑盒蒸馏。GAD将学生LLM构建为一个生成器，并训练一个判别器来区分其响应和教师LLM的响应，从而创建了一个极小极大博弈。判别器充当与学生模型共同演化的在策略奖励模型，提供稳定、自适应的反馈。实验结果表明，GAD持续优于常用的序列级知识蒸馏。特别是，使用GAD训练的Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct（学生模型）在LMSYS-Chat自动评估中与它的教师模型GPT-5-Chat相当。这些结果确立了GAD作为黑盒LLM蒸馏的一种有前景且有效的范式。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为生成对抗蒸馏（GAD）的新范式，用于实现大语言模型的黑盒在策略蒸馏。GAD利用生成对抗框架，将学生模型视为生成器，并训练判别器作为自适应的在策略奖励模型，通过极小极大博弈进行训练。实验证明，GAD持续超越传统的序列级知识蒸馏方法，并能使学生模型（如Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct）在自动评估中达到与其专有教师模型（如GPT-5-Chat）相当的性能。
AI.keywords: 黑盒蒸馏, 在策略蒸馏, 生成对抗蒸馏, 大语言模型, 知识蒸馏
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于将生成对抗网络（GAN）框架应用于黑盒在策略蒸馏，有效地利用判别器作为自适应的奖励模型，解决了在无法访问内部参数的情况下进行有效策略优化的核心难题。其重要性在于提供了一种高效、可行的途径，将强大的专有模型（如GPT-5-Chat）的能力转移到更小、更开放的模型中，对于AI技术的普及具有重大价值。抽象中未提及训练判别器的具体计算成本，这可能是实际应用中的一个潜在限制。

title: Enhancing Graph Representations with Neighborhood-Contextualized Message-Passing
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) have become an indispensable tool for analyzing relational data. Classical GNNs are broadly classified into three variants: convolutional, attentional, and message-passing. While the standard message-passing variant is expressive, its typical pair-wise messages only consider the features of the center node and each neighboring node individually. This design fails to incorporate contextual information contained within the broader local neighborhood, potentially hindering its ability to learn complex relationships within the entire set of neighboring nodes. To address this limitation, this work first formalizes the concept of neighborhood-contextualization, rooted in a key property of the attentional variant. This then serves as the foundation for generalizing the message-passing variant to the proposed neighborhood-contextualized message-passing (NCMP) framework. To demonstrate its utility, a simple, practical, and efficient method to parametrize and operationalize NCMP is presented, leading to the development of the proposed Soft-Isomorphic Neighborhood-Contextualized Graph Convolution Network (SINC-GCN). Across a diverse set of synthetic and benchmark GNN datasets, SINC-GCN demonstrates competitive performance against baseline GNN models, highlighting its expressivity and efficiency. Notably, it also delivers substantial and statistically significant performance gains in graph property prediction tasks, further underscoring the distinctive utility of neighborhood-contextualization. Overall, the paper lays the foundation for the NCMP framework as a practical path toward enhancing the graph representational power of classical GNNs.

AI.title_translation: 使用邻域语境化消息传递增强图表示
AI.tldr: 经典的图神经网络（GNN）消息传递机制缺乏邻域语境信息。本文提出了邻域语境化消息传递（NCMP）框架，并实现了一个高效的模型SINC-GCN，该模型在各种任务中表现出色，尤其在图属性预测上获得了显著提升。
AI.motivation: 经典的GNN消息传递变体只考虑中心节点和单个邻居节点的特征，缺乏对更广泛局部邻域中语境信息的整合，这限制了其学习整组邻居节点内复杂关系的能力。
AI.method: 首先形式化了“邻域语境化”的概念（源于注意力变体的关键特性），并以此为基础，将标准消息传递变体推广到所提出的“邻域语境化消息传递”（NCMP）框架。随后，提出了一个简单、实用且高效的参数化和操作化方法，从而开发了Soft-Isomorphic Neighborhood-Contextualized Graph Convolution Network (SINC-GCN)。
AI.result: SINC-GCN在各种合成和基准GNN数据集上与基线模型相比表现出有竞争力的性能。值得注意的是，它在图属性预测任务中取得了实质性且具有统计学意义的显著性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 本文奠定了NCMP框架的基础，将其作为增强经典GNN的图表示能力提供了一条实用的途径。
AI.translation: 图神经网络（GNN）已成为分析关系数据不可或缺的工具。经典的GNN大致分为三种变体：卷积型、注意力型和消息传递型。虽然标准的消息传递变体具有表达力，但其典型的成对消息只单独考虑中心节点和每个邻居节点的特征。这种设计未能整合更广泛局部邻域中包含的语境信息，可能会阻碍其学习整组邻居节点内复杂关系的能力。为了解决这一限制，本文首先形式化了邻域语境化的概念，该概念植根于注意力变体的一个关键特性。这随后成为将消息传递变体推广到所提出的邻域语境化消息传递（NCMP）框架的基础。为了证明其实用性，本文提出了一种简单、实用且高效的方法来参数化和操作化NCMP，从而开发了所提出的Soft-Isomorphic Neighborhood-Contextualized Graph Convolution Network (SINC-GCN)。在一系列多样化的合成和基准GNN数据集上，SINC-GCN与基线GNN模型相比展现出有竞争力的性能，突显了其表达能力和效率。值得注意的是，它还在图属性预测任务中提供了实质性且具有统计学意义的显著性能提升，进一步强调了邻域语境化的独特效用。总而言之，本文为NCMP框架奠定了基础，将其作为增强经典GNN图表示能力的一条实用路径。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新的图表示学习框架——邻域语境化消息传递（NCMP），以解决传统GNN消息传递机制在整合局部邻域整体语境信息方面的不足。通过形式化邻域语境化概念并将其应用于消息传递，本文开发了具体的实现模型SINC-GCN。实验证明SINC-GCN在通用GNN任务上具有竞争力，并在图属性预测任务中实现了显著的性能提升，有效增强了经典GNN的表示能力。
AI.keywords: 图神经网络, 消息传递, 邻域语境化, 图表示, SINC-GCN
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于形式化了“邻域语境化”的概念，并将其作为基础，弥补了经典消息传递GNN只关注成对消息而忽略更广泛局部邻域语境信息的缺陷。通过提出NCMP框架和具体的实现模型SINC-GCN，该研究提供了一条增强GNN表示能力、提高其在复杂关系（尤其是图属性预测）上性能的实用途径。这一工作对于推动消息传递范式向更具表达力的方向发展具有重要意义。

title: Donors and Recipients: On Asymmetric Transfer Across Tasks and Languages with Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) perform strongly across tasks and languages, yet how improvements in one task or language affect other tasks and languages remains poorly understood. We conduct a controlled LoRA fine-tuning study across multiple open-weight LLM families and scales, using a standardised grid of 11 languages and four benchmarks. We fine-tune each model on a single task-language source and measure transfer when evaluated on all other task-language target pairs. We decompose transfer into three regimes: (i) Matched-Task (Cross-Language), (ii) Matched-Language (Cross-Task), and (iii) Cross-Task (Cross-Language). Single-source fine-tuning yields a net positive uplift across regimes, but the gains are strongly asymmetric. Matched-Task (Cross-Language) transfer emerges as the most effective and predictable regime, driven principally by the identity of the target language rather than model architecture. We identify a stable hierarchy where high-resource languages and broad semantic tasks act as efficient recipients that absorb gains from diverse sources, while specialised tasks and lower-resource languages are more isolated. These results imply that effective fine-tuning requires navigating donor-recipient roles to maximise downstream gains.

AI.title_translation: 捐赠者与接受者：基于参数高效微调的跨任务和跨语言的非对称迁移研究
AI.tldr: 研究了使用LoRA进行单源微调时，LLM在跨任务和跨语言场景中的知识迁移模式。发现迁移增益是非对称的，其中“任务匹配/跨语言”迁移最有效。高资源语言和宽泛任务是高效的知识接受者，低资源语言和专业任务则较为孤立。
AI.motivation: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在各种任务和语言上表现出色，但目前对于在一个任务或语言上的改进如何影响其他任务和语言的机制理解不足。
AI.method: 采用参数高效微调（LoRA）方法，在多个开源LLM系列和规模上进行受控研究。使用一个包含11种语言和4个基准测试的标准化网格。在单一任务-语言源上进行微调，然后测量其到所有其他任务-语言目标对的迁移效果。将迁移分解为三种机制：任务匹配（跨语言）、语言匹配（跨任务）和跨任务（跨语言）。
AI.result: 单源微调在所有机制中都能带来净积极提升，但增益具有强烈的非对称性。“任务匹配（跨语言）”迁移是最有效和可预测的机制，主要由目标语言的特性驱动，而非模型架构。研究发现了一个稳定的层级结构：高资源语言和宽泛语义任务是高效的接受者，能吸收来自不同来源的增益，而专业化任务和低资源语言则更为孤立。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，有效的微调需要明确界定“捐赠者”和“接受者”的角色，以最大限度地提高下游收益。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在各种任务和语言上表现出色，但对于在一个任务或语言上的改进如何影响其他任务和语言的机制，目前理解不足。我们进行了一项受控的LoRA微调研究，涉及多个开源LLM系列和规模，使用一个包含11种语言和四个基准测试的标准化网格。我们在单一任务-语言源上对每个模型进行微调，并测量其在所有其他任务-语言目标对上评估时的迁移效果。我们将迁移分解为三种机制：（i）任务匹配（跨语言），（ii）语言匹配（跨任务），以及（iii）跨任务（跨语言）。单源微调在所有机制中都能带来净积极提升，但增益具有强烈的非对称性。任务匹配（跨语言）迁移是最有效和可预测的机制，主要由目标语言的特性驱动，而非模型架构。我们确定了一个稳定的层级结构：高资源语言和宽泛语义任务是高效的接受者，能够吸收来自不同来源的增益，而专业化任务和低资源语言则更为孤立。这些结果表明，有效的微调需要管理捐赠者和接受者的角色，以最大限度地提高下游收益。
AI.summary: 本文通过一项受控的LoRA微调实验，系统研究了大型语言模型（LLMs）在跨任务和跨语言场景中的知识迁移模式。研究使用了11种语言和4个基准测试，将迁移分为任务匹配/跨语言、语言匹配/跨任务和跨任务/跨语言三种机制。结果显示，微调带来的增益是非对称的，其中任务匹配（跨语言）迁移最有效。文章提出了一个“捐赠者-接受者”的层级结构：高资源语言和宽泛任务是高效的接受者，而低资源语言和专业任务则较为孤立。研究强调了在参数高效微调中，明确“捐赠者”和“接受者”角色的重要性。
AI.keywords: 参数高效微调, LoRA, 知识迁移, 跨语言, 跨任务, 非对称性
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于系统性地量化和分解了参数高效微调（LoRA）在LLMs中诱导的跨任务和跨语言的知识迁移模式。通过引入“捐赠者”和“接受者”的概念，并识别出高资源语言和宽泛任务作为高效接受者的稳定层级结构，为LLMs的有效微调策略提供了重要的指导意义。它强调了在设计微调方案时，需要考虑目标语言和任务的特性，而不仅仅依赖于模型架构，这对于资源受限或多语言应用场景具有重要的实践价值。

title: Non-Linear Scoring Model for Translation Quality Evaluation
summary:
Analytic Translation Quality Evaluation (TQE), based on Multidimensional Quality Metrics (MQM), traditionally uses a linear error-to-penalty scale calibrated to a reference sample of 1000-2000 words. However, linear extrapolation biases judgment on samples of different sizes, over-penalizing short samples and under-penalizing long ones, producing misalignment with expert intuition.
  Building on the Multi-Range framework, this paper presents a calibrated, non-linear scoring model that better reflects how human content consumers perceive translation quality across samples of varying length. Empirical data from three large-scale enterprise environments shows that acceptable error counts grow logarithmically, not linearly, with sample size.
  Psychophysical and cognitive evidence, including the Weber-Fechner law and Cognitive Load Theory, supports this premise by explaining why the perceptual impact of additional errors diminishes while the cognitive burden grows with scale. We propose a two-parameter model
  E(x) = a * ln(1 + b * x), a, b > 0,
  anchored to a reference tolerance and calibrated from two tolerance points using a one-dimensional root-finding step. The model yields an explicit interval within which the linear approximation stays within +/-20 percent relative error and integrates into existing evaluation workflows with only a dynamic tolerance function added.
  The approach improves interpretability, fairness, and inter-rater reliability across both human and AI-generated translations. By operationalizing a perceptually valid scoring paradigm, it advances translation quality evaluation toward more accurate and scalable assessment. The model also provides a stronger basis for AI-based document-level evaluation aligned with human judgment. Implementation considerations for CAT/LQA systems and implications for human and AI-generated text evaluation are discussed.

AI.title_translation: 翻译质量评估的非线性评分模型
AI.tldr: 传统的翻译评分模型因样本长度而产生偏差。本文提出一个基于认知科学和实证数据的非线性（对数）模型，以提高人工和AI翻译评估的公平性和准确性。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于MQM的分析性翻译质量评估（TQE）使用线性误差-惩罚量表，导致对不同长度样本的判断存在偏差（短样本惩罚过度，长样本惩罚不足），从而与专家直觉不符。
AI.method: 提出一个基于Multi-Range框架的校准非线性评分模型。该模型基于认知和心理物理学证据（如韦伯-费希纳定律和认知负荷理论），认为可接受的错误数量随样本大小呈对数增长。具体模型形式为 $E(x) = a \cdot \ln(1 + b \cdot x)$，通过一个一维寻根步骤，利用两个容忍点进行校准，并以动态容忍度函数的形式集成到现有评估工作流程中。
AI.result: 来自三个大型企业环境的经验数据显示，可接受的错误数量随样本大小呈对数增长。该模型明确界定了一个区间，在此区间内，线性近似的相对误差保持在正负20%以内。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提高了人工和AI生成翻译评估的解释性、公平性和评估者间可靠性。通过实现感知上有效的评分范式，它使翻译质量评估更加准确和可扩展，并为与人类判断一致的AI文档级评估提供了更坚实的基础。
AI.translation:
基于多维质量指标（MQM）的分析性翻译质量评估（TQE）传统上使用线性误差-惩罚量表，该量表通常以1000-2000词的参考样本进行校准。然而，线性外推会导致对不同大小样本的判断产生偏差，过度惩罚短样本，而惩罚不足长样本，从而与专家直觉产生错位。

本文以Multi-Range框架为基础，提出了一个经过校准的非线性评分模型，该模型能更好地反映人类内容消费者对不同长度样本翻译质量的感知。来自三个大型企业环境的经验数据显示，可接受的错误数量随样本大小呈对数增长，而非线性增长。

心理物理学和认知证据，包括韦伯-费希纳定律和认知负荷理论，支持了这一前提，解释了为什么额外错误带来的感知影响会减弱，而认知负担却随规模增长。我们提出了一个双参数模型：$E(x) = a \cdot \ln(1 + b \cdot x)$，其中 $a, b > 0$。该模型以参考容忍度为锚点，并使用一维寻根步骤通过两个容忍点进行校准。

该模型产生了一个明确的区间，在此区间内，线性近似的相对误差保持在正负20%以内，并且只需增加一个动态容忍度函数即可集成到现有评估工作流程中。

该方法提高了人工和AI生成翻译的解释性、公平性和评估者间可靠性。通过实现感知上有效的评分范式，它推动翻译质量评估朝着更准确和可扩展的评估发展。该模型还为与人类判断一致的AI文档级评估提供了更坚实的基础。论文讨论了计算机辅助翻译（CAT）/语言质量保证（LQA）系统的实现考量以及对人工和AI生成文本评估的影响。
AI.summary: 针对传统翻译质量评估中线性评分模型对不同长度样本的偏差问题，本文提出了一种基于Multi-Range框架的校准非线性评分模型。该模型基于韦伯-费希纳定律等认知证据，认为可接受的错误数量随样本长度呈对数增长 $E(x) = a \cdot \ln(1 + b \cdot x)$。经验数据支持了这一对数增长假设。该非线性模型提高了评估的公平性、可解释性和可靠性，能更好地对齐人类对不同规模翻译质量的感知判断，并为AI文档级评估提供了更强基础。
AI.keywords: 非线性评分模型, 翻译质量评估, MQM, 韦伯-费希纳定律, 认知负荷理论
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将翻译质量评估（TQE）从纯粹的线性、机械系统提升到一个基于心理物理学（韦伯-费希纳定律）和认知理论（认知负荷理论）的范式。这种转变使得评估指标在感知上有效，将客观评分与人类对不同规模内容的错误容忍度的主观直觉对齐。这一方法提高了评估的公平性和可解释性，对于解决传统线性模型在处理不同长度样本时的固有偏差至关重要，尤其适用于现代高容量、自动化评估系统和AI生成的文档级评估。

title: N-GLARE: An Non-Generative Latent Representation-Efficient LLM Safety Evaluator
summary: Evaluating the safety robustness of LLMs is critical for their deployment. However, mainstream Red Teaming methods rely on online generation and black-box output analysis. These approaches are not only costly but also suffer from feedback latency, making them unsuitable for agile diagnostics after training a new model. To address this, we propose N-GLARE (A Non-Generative, Latent Representation-Efficient LLM Safety Evaluator). N-GLARE operates entirely on the model's latent representations, bypassing the need for full text generation. It characterizes hidden layer dynamics by analyzing the APT (Angular-Probabilistic Trajectory) of latent representations and introducing the JSS (Jensen-Shannon Separability) metric. Experiments on over 40 models and 20 red teaming strategies demonstrate that the JSS metric exhibits high consistency with the safety rankings derived from Red Teaming. N-GLARE reproduces the discriminative trends of large-scale red-teaming tests at less than 1\% of the token cost and the runtime cost, providing an efficient output-free evaluation proxy for real-time diagnostics.

AI.title_translation: N-GLARE：一个非生成式、潜在表征高效的LLM安全评估器
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为N-GLARE的新型LLM安全评估方法，该方法不依赖生成文本，而是通过分析模型的潜在表征来评估其安全性，成本低、效率高。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM安全评估方法（如红队测试）依赖于在线生成和黑盒输出分析，成本高且存在反馈延迟，不适用于模型训练后的敏捷诊断。
AI.method: N-GLARE通过分析潜在表征的APT（角度概率轨迹）并引入JSS（Jensen-Shannon可分性）指标来表征隐藏层动态，完全在模型的潜在表征上操作，无需生成文本。
AI.result: 实验表明，JSS指标与红队测试得出的安全排名高度一致，N-GLARE的成本不到红队测试的1%，能够高效地进行无输出评估。
AI.conclusion: N-GLARE是一种高效的、无输出的LLM安全评估代理，能够以极低的成本实时诊断，并且其评估结果与大规模红队测试高度一致。
AI.translation: 评估LLM的安全鲁棒性对于其部署至关重要。然而，主流的红队测试方法依赖于在线生成和黑盒输出分析。这些方法不仅成本高昂，而且存在反馈延迟，不适合在训练新模型后的敏捷诊断。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了N-GLARE（一个非生成式、潜在表征高效的LLM安全评估器）。N-GLARE完全在模型的潜在表征上操作，无需进行完整的文本生成。它通过分析潜在表征的APT（角度概率轨迹）并引入JSS（Jensen-Shannon可分性）指标来表征隐藏层动态。在对40多个模型和20种红队测试策略进行的实验表明，JSS指标与红队测试得出的安全排名高度一致。N-GLARE以不到1%的代币成本和运行时间成本，重现了大规模红队测试的区分趋势，为实时诊断提供了一种高效的无输出评估代理。
AI.summary: N-GLARE是一种创新的LLM安全评估工具，它通过分析模型的潜在表征而非生成文本来评估安全性。该方法利用APT和JSS指标，实现了与传统红队测试相似的安全排名，但成本显著降低（不到1%），并且消除了反馈延迟，为LLM的快速安全诊断提供了高效的解决方案。
AI.keywords: LLM安全评估, 非生成式评估, 潜在表征, APT, JSS
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖且高效的LLM安全评估方法，解决了现有方法的成本和延迟问题。通过利用潜在表征进行评估，N-GLARE有望成为LLM安全部署的重要工具。其低成本和高效率的特点使其在实际应用中具有巨大潜力。

title: Clinically-Validated Innovative Mobile Application for Assessing Blinking and Eyelid Movements
authors: Bárbara Moreira Ribeiro Trindade dos Santos
summary: Blinking is a vital physiological process that protects and maintains the health of the ocular surface. Objective assessment of eyelid movements remains challenging due to the complexity, cost, and limited clinical applicability of existing tools. This study presents the Bapp (Blink Application), a mobile application developed using the Flutter framework and integrated with Google ML Kit for on-device, real-time analysis of eyelid movements, and its clinical validation. The validation was performed using 45 videos from patients, whose blinks were manually annotated by an ophthalmology specialist as the ground truth. The Bapp's performance was evaluated using standard metrics, with results demonstrating 98.4% precision, 96.9% recall, and an overall accuracy of 98.3%. These outcomes confirm the reliability of the Bapp as a portable, accessible, and objective tool for monitoring eyelid movements. The application offers a promising alternative to traditional manual blink counting, supporting continuous ocular health monitoring and postoperative evaluation in clinical environments.

AI.title_translation: 临床验证的创新移动应用程序，用于评估眨眼和眼睑运动
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为 Bapp 的移动应用程序，使用 Flutter 和 Google ML Kit 进行实时眼睑运动分析，并通过 45 个患者视频进行了临床验证，结果显示其精度、召回率和准确率均达到 98% 以上，证明了其作为便携、可访问和客观的眼睑运动监测工具的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有评估眼睑运动的工具存在复杂、成本高和临床应用受限的挑战。
AI.method: 使用 Flutter 框架和 Google ML Kit 开发了一个名为 Bapp 的移动应用程序，用于在设备上进行实时眼睑运动分析。通过 45 个患者视频进行临床验证，并与眼科专家手动标注的眨眼数据进行比较。
AI.result: Bapp 在评估中的表现：精确率为 98.4%，召回率为 96.9%，总体准确率为 98.3%。
AI.conclusion: Bapp 被证实是一种可靠的、便携的、可访问的、客观的眼睑运动监测工具，为传统的手动眨眼计数提供了一种有前景的替代方案，支持临床环境中的持续眼部健康监测和术后评估。
AI.translation: 眨眼是一个至关重要的生理过程，可保护和维持眼表健康。由于现有工具的复杂性、成本高昂以及临床适用性有限，眼睑运动的客观评估仍然具有挑战性。本研究提出了 Bapp（眨眼应用程序），这是一款使用 Flutter 框架开发并集成了 Google ML Kit 的移动应用程序，用于在设备上进行实时眼睑运动分析，并对其进行了临床验证。验证过程使用了 45 个患者视频，其眨眼由眼科专家手动标注作为真实情况。Bapp 的性能使用标准指标进行了评估，结果显示其精确率为 98.4%，召回率为 96.9%，总体准确率为 98.3%。这些结果证实了 Bapp 作为一种便携、可访问且客观的眼睑运动监测工具的可靠性。该应用程序为传统的手动眨眼计数提供了一种有前景的替代方案，支持临床环境中的持续眼部健康监测和术后评估。
AI.summary: 本研究介绍了一款名为 Bapp 的创新移动应用程序，它利用 Flutter 和 Google ML Kit 在设备上实时分析眼睑运动。通过对 45 个患者视频进行临床验证，Bapp 达到了 98.4% 的精确率、96.9% 的召回率和 98.3% 的准确率，证明了其作为一种便携、易用且客观的眼睑运动监测工具的有效性，可用于持续的眼部健康监测和术后评估。
AI.keywords: 眨眼应用程序,眼睑运动,移动健康,临床验证,实时分析
AI.comments: 该研究成功开发并验证了一款移动应用程序，用于客观评估眨眼和眼睑运动，解决了现有方法的局限性。其高精度和召回率表明了该方法的潜力，但未来的研究可以探索其在更多样化人群和不同临床场景下的应用，并评估其长期使用的影响。

title: Nonholonomic Robot Parking by Feedback -- Part I: Modular Strict CLF Designs
comments: arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2509.25575
summary: It has been known in the robotics literature since about 1995 that, in polar coordinates, the nonholonomic unicycle is asymptotically stabilizable by smooth feedback, even globally. We introduce a modular design framework that selects the forward velocity to decouple the radial coordinate, allowing the steering subsystem to be stabilized independently. Within this structure, we develop families of feedback laws using passivity, backstepping, and integrator forwarding. Each law is accompanied by a strict control Lyapunov function, including barrier variants that enforce angular constraints. These strict CLFs provide constructive class KL convergence estimates and enable eigenvalue assignment at the target equilibrium. The framework generalizes and extends prior modular and nonmodular approaches, while preparing the ground for inverse optimal and adaptive redesigns in the sequel paper.
comment: arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2509.25575

AI.title_translation: 反馈式非完整性机器人停车 -- 第一部分：模块化严格控制李雅普诺夫函数设计
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种模块化框架，用于设计非完整性机器人（特别是独轮车）的停车控制律，利用李雅普诺夫函数确保稳定性和收敛性。
AI.motivation: 机器人停车问题，特别是对于具有非完整性约束的机器人，其稳定性和全局可控性是关键挑战。现有方法在设计和收敛性保证方面有待改进。
AI.method: 提出了一种模块化设计框架，将径向坐标解耦，允许独立稳定转向子系统。利用了李雅普诺夫函数（CLF），特别是严格CLF和其变体（如障碍CLF），结合了能量化、后退和积分前馈等控制设计技术。
AI.result: 开发了多种反馈律，并提供了严格CLF保证，实现了类KL收敛估计，并允许在目标平衡点进行特征值分配。该框架扩展和推广了先前的方法。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功开发了一种模块化框架，用于设计非完整性机器人的停车控制器，并通过严格CLF提供了理论保证，为后续研究奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 自1995年以来，机器人学文献已知，在极坐标下，非完整性独轮车可以通过光滑反馈实现渐近稳定，甚至是全局稳定。我们引入了一个模块化设计框架，选择前向速度来解耦径向坐标，从而允许独立稳定转向子系统。在此框架内，我们开发了使用能量化、后退和积分前馈的反馈律族。每个律都伴随着一个严格的控制李雅普诺夫函数（CLF），包括强制角度约束的障碍变体。这些严格CLF提供了构造性的类KL收敛估计，并允许在目标平衡点进行特征值分配。该框架推广和扩展了先前模块化和非模块化方法，并为续篇中的逆最优和自适应重新设计做好了准备。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种用于非完整性机器人停车的模块化控制设计框架。该框架通过选择前向速度来解耦径向坐标，从而独立地稳定转向子系统。研究人员利用能量化、后退和积分前馈等技术，结合严格控制李雅普诺夫函数（CLF），包括带角度约束的障碍CLF，开发了一系列反馈律。这些严格CLF提供了明确的收敛性保证，并支持在目标点进行特征值分配。该框架不仅扩展了现有的模块化和非模块化方法，还为后续研究中的最优和自适应控制设计铺平了道路。
AI.keywords: 非完整性机器人, 机器人停车, 控制李雅普诺夫函数, 模块化设计, 反馈控制
AI.comments: 该研究在非完整性机器人停车控制领域取得了重要进展，通过提出模块化设计框架和严格CLF，提供了更强的稳定性和收敛性保证。其模块化设计思路具有良好的扩展性和通用性，为解决更复杂的机器人控制问题提供了新的视角。然而，实际应用中的鲁棒性和计算复杂度仍需进一步考察。

title: SCoTER: Structured Chain-of-Thought Transfer for Enhanced Recommendation
comments: Due to some internal company policies, we need to temporarily withdraw the paper. We will resubmit it after a further review
summary: Harnessing the reasoning power of Large Language Models (LLMs) for recommender systems is hindered by two fundamental challenges. First, current approaches lack a mechanism for automated, data-driven discovery of effective reasoning patterns, relying instead on brittle manual templates or unstable zero-shot prompting. Second, they employ structure-collapsing integration: direct prompting incurs prohibitive online inference costs, while feature extraction collapses reasoning chains into single vectors, discarding stepwise logic. To address these challenges, we propose SCoTER (Structured Chain-of-Thought Transfer for Enhanced Recommendation), a unified framework that treats pattern discovery and structure-aware transfer as a jointly optimized problem. Specifically, SCoTER operationalizes this through two synergistic components: a GVM pipeline for automated pattern discovery and a structure-preserving integration architecture that transfers stepwise logic to efficient models. Formally, we provide information-theoretic justification proving that structure-preserving transfer achieves tighter performance bounds than structure-agnostic alternatives. Empirically, experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate improvements of 3.75\%-11.59\% over a strong TIGER backbone. Moreover, in production deployment on the Tencent Advertising Platform, SCoTER achieved a 2.14\% lift in Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) while eliminating online LLM inference costs. Overall, SCoTER establishes a principled and production-validated blueprint for transferring structured LLM reasoning to large-scale recommender systems.

AI.title_translation: 结构化思维链转移以增强推荐
AI.tldr: SCoTER框架通过自动化发现推理模式和保留结构的方式，将LLM的推理能力有效迁移到推荐系统中，解决了现有方法在模式发现和结构整合上的不足，并在实验和实际应用中均取得了显著效果。
AI.motivation: 现有推荐系统在利用LLM进行推理时，面临自动发现有效推理模式的困难以及结构崩溃的整合问题（在线推理成本高或特征提取丢失逐步逻辑）。
AI.method: 提出SCoTER框架，将模式发现和结构感知转移作为联合优化问题。具体包括：1. 使用GVM流水线自动发现模式；2. 设计保留结构的整合架构，将逐步逻辑迁移到高效模型。理论上，通过信息论证明了保留结构的转移比不考虑结构的转移有更好的性能界限。
AI.result: 在四个基准测试上，SCoTER相比TIGER骨干网络有3.75%-11.59%的提升。在腾讯广告平台上的实际部署，GMV提升了2.14%，同时消除了在线LLM推理成本。
AI.conclusion: SCoTER为将结构化LLM推理迁移到大规模推荐系统提供了一个有原则且经过生产验证的蓝图。
AI.translation: 利用大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力来构建推荐系统面临两个基本挑战。首先，现有方法缺乏一种机制来自动、以数据驱动的方式发现有效的推理模式，而是依赖于脆弱的手动模板或不稳定的零样本提示。其次，它们采用结构崩溃整合：直接提示会产生高昂的在线推理成本，而特征提取会将推理链崩溃为单个向量，从而丢弃了逐步逻辑。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了SCoTER（结构化思维链转移以增强推荐），这是一个统一的框架，将模式发现和结构感知转移视为一个联合优化的过程。具体来说，SCoTER通过两个协同组件来实现：一个用于自动模式发现的GVM流水线和一个用于将逐步逻辑迁移到高效模型的、保留结构的整合架构。形式上，我们提供了信息论的理由，证明了保留结构的转移比非结构感知的替代方案能获得更严格的性能界限。在经验上，在四个基准测试上的实验表明，相比强大的TIGER骨干网络，性能有了3.75%-11.59%的提升。此外，在腾讯广告平台的生产部署中，SCoTER实现了2.14%的商品交易总额（GMV）提升，同时消除了在线LLM推理成本。总的来说，SCoTER为将结构化LLM推理迁移到大规模推荐系统提供了一个有原则且经过生产验证的蓝图。
AI.summary: SCoTER是一个新框架，通过联合优化模式发现和结构化转移，解决了现有LLM推荐系统中的推理模式发现和结构整合问题。它利用GVM流水线自动发现推理模式，并采用保留结构的整合方式将逐步逻辑迁移到高效模型，从而在实验和实际应用中均取得了显著的性能提升和成本效益。
AI.keywords: 结构化思维链, 推荐系统, 大型语言模型, 模式发现, 结构感知转移
AI.comments: 该研究解决了LLM在推荐系统中应用的关键挑战，即如何有效地发现和迁移推理模式，同时避免高昂的计算成本。SCoTER框架通过提出联合优化模式发现和结构化转移的方法，并在理论和实践中都验证了其有效性，具有重要的理论和应用价值。特别是在实际生产环境中取得GMV提升和成本消除的成果，凸显了该方法的实用性。

title: StreamFlow: Theory, Algorithm, and Implementation for High-Efficiency Rectified Flow Generation
comments: Improved the quality. Project Page at https://world-snapshot.github.io/StreamFlow/
summary: New technologies such as Rectified Flow and Flow Matching have significantly improved the performance of generative models in the past two years, especially in terms of control accuracy, generation quality, and generation efficiency. However, due to some differences in its theory, design, and existing diffusion models, the existing acceleration methods cannot be directly applied to the Rectified Flow model. In this article, we have comprehensively implemented an overall acceleration pipeline from the aspects of theory, design, and reasoning strategies. This pipeline uses new methods such as batch processing with a new velocity field, vectorization of heterogeneous time-step batch processing, and dynamic TensorRT compilation for the new methods to comprehensively accelerate related models based on flow models. Currently, the existing public methods usually achieve an acceleration of 18%, while experiments have proved that our new method can accelerate the 512*512 image generation speed to up to 611%, which is far beyond the current non-generalized acceleration methods.
comment: Improved the quality. Project Page at https://world-snapshot.github.io/StreamFlow/

title: Multi-Modal AI for Remote Patient Monitoring in Cancer Care
summary: For patients undergoing systemic cancer therapy, the time between clinic visits is full of uncertainties and risks of unmonitored side effects. To bridge this gap in care, we developed and prospectively trialed a multi-modal AI framework for remote patient monitoring (RPM). This system integrates multi-modal data from the HALO-X platform, such as demographics, wearable sensors, daily surveys, and clinical events. Our observational trial is one of the largest of its kind and has collected over 2.1 million data points (6,080 patient-days) of monitoring from 84 patients. We developed and adapted a multi-modal AI model to handle the asynchronous and incomplete nature of real-world RPM data, forecasting a continuous risk of future adverse events. The model achieved an accuracy of 83.9% (AUROC=0.70). Notably, the model identified previous treatments, wellness check-ins, and daily maximum heart rate as key predictive features. A case study demonstrated the model's ability to provide early warnings by outputting escalating risk profiles prior to the event. This work establishes the feasibility of multi-modal AI RPM for cancer care and offers a path toward more proactive patient support.(Accepted at Europe NeurIPS 2025 Multimodal Representation Learning for Healthcare Workshop. Best Paper Poster Award.)

title: BlurDM: A Blur Diffusion Model for Image Deblurring
summary: Diffusion models show promise for dynamic scene deblurring; however, existing studies often fail to leverage the intrinsic nature of the blurring process within diffusion models, limiting their full potential. To address it, we present a Blur Diffusion Model (BlurDM), which seamlessly integrates the blur formation process into diffusion for image deblurring. Observing that motion blur stems from continuous exposure, BlurDM implicitly models the blur formation process through a dual-diffusion forward scheme, diffusing both noise and blur onto a sharp image. During the reverse generation process, we derive a dual denoising and deblurring formulation, enabling BlurDM to recover the sharp image by simultaneously denoising and deblurring, given pure Gaussian noise conditioned on the blurred image as input. Additionally, to efficiently integrate BlurDM into deblurring networks, we perform BlurDM in the latent space, forming a flexible prior generation network for deblurring. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BlurDM significantly and consistently enhances existing deblurring methods on four benchmark datasets. The project page is available at https://jin-ting-he.github.io/BlurDM/.

title: MAFNet:Multi-frequency Adaptive Fusion Network for Real-time Stereo Matching
summary: Existing stereo matching networks typically rely on either cost-volume construction based on 3D convolutions or deformation methods based on iterative optimization. The former incurs significant computational overhead during cost aggregation, whereas the latter often lacks the ability to model non-local contextual information. These methods exhibit poor compatibility on resource-constrained mobile devices, limiting their deployment in real-time applications. To address this, we propose a Multi-frequency Adaptive Fusion Network (MAFNet), which can produce high-quality disparity maps using only efficient 2D convolutions. Specifically, we design an adaptive frequency-domain filtering attention module that decomposes the full cost volume into high-frequency and low-frequency volumes, performing frequency-aware feature aggregation separately. Subsequently, we introduce a Linformer-based low-rank attention mechanism to adaptively fuse high- and low-frequency information, yielding more robust disparity estimation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed MAFNet significantly outperforms existing real-time methods on public datasets such as Scene Flow and KITTI 2015, showing a favorable balance between accuracy and real-time performance.

title: Interleaved Latent Visual Reasoning with Selective Perceptual Modeling
comments: 18 pages, 11 figures. Code available at https://github.com/XD111ds/ILVR
summary: Interleaved reasoning paradigms enhance Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) with visual feedback but are hindered by the prohibitive computational cost of re-encoding pixel-dense images. A promising alternative, latent visual reasoning, circumvents this bottleneck yet faces limitations: methods either fail to capture intermediate state evolution due to single-step, non-interleaved structures, or sacrifice precise perceptual modeling by over-compressing features. We introduce Interleaved Latent Visual Reasoning (ILVR), a framework that unifies dynamic state evolution with precise perceptual modeling. ILVR interleaves textual generation with latent visual representations that act as specific, evolving cues for subsequent reasoning. Specifically, we employ a self-supervision strategy where a momentum teacher model selectively distills relevant features from ground-truth intermediate images into sparse supervision targets. This adaptive selection mechanism guides the model to autonomously generate context-aware visual signals. Extensive experiments on multimodal reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that ILVR outperforms existing approaches, effectively bridging the gap between fine-grained perception and sequential multimodal reasoning.
comment: 18 pages, 11 figures. Code available at https://github.com/XD111ds/ILVR

title: CHIMERA: Adaptive Cache Injection and Semantic Anchor Prompting for Zero-shot Image Morphing with Morphing-oriented Metrics
comments: Please visit our project page at https://cmlab-korea.github.io/CHIMERA/
summary: Diffusion models exhibit remarkable generative ability, yet achieving smooth and semantically consistent image morphing remains a challenge. Existing approaches often yield abrupt transitions or over-saturated appearances due to the lack of adaptive structural and semantic alignments. We propose CHIMERA, a zero-shot diffusion-based framework that formulates morphing as a cached inversion-guided denoising process. To handle large semantic and appearance disparities, we propose Adaptive Cache Injection and Semantic Anchor Prompting. Adaptive Cache Injection (ACI) caches down, mid, and up blocks features from both inputs during DDIM inversion and re-injects them adaptively during denoising, enabling spatial and semantic alignment in depth- and time-adaptive manners and enabling natural feature fusion and smooth transitions. Semantic Anchor Prompting (SAP) leverages a vision-language model to generate a shared anchor prompt that serves as a semantic anchor, bridging dissimilar inputs and guiding the denoising process toward coherent results. Finally, we introduce the Global-Local Consistency Score (GLCS), a morphing-oriented metric that simultaneously evaluates the global harmonization of the two inputs and the smoothness of the local morphing transition. Extensive experiments and user studies show that CHIMERA achieves smoother and more semantically aligned transitions than existing methods, establishing a new state of the art in image morphing. The code and project page will be publicly released.
comment: Please visit our project page at https://cmlab-korea.github.io/CHIMERA/

title: TPA: Next Token Probability Attribution for Detecting Hallucinations in RAG
summary: Detecting hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented Generation remains a challenge. Prior approaches attribute hallucinations to a binary conflict between internal knowledge stored in FFNs and the retrieved context. However, this perspective is incomplete, failing to account for the impact of other components of the LLM, such as the user query, previously generated tokens, the self token, and the final LayerNorm adjustment. To comprehensively capture the impact of these components on hallucination detection, we propose TPA which mathematically attributes each token's probability to seven distinct sources: Query, RAG Context, Past Token, Self Token, FFN, Final LayerNorm, and Initial Embedding. This attribution quantifies how each source contributes to the generation of the next token. Specifically, we aggregate these attribution scores by Part-of-Speech (POS) tags to quantify the contribution of each model component to the generation of specific linguistic categories within a response. By leveraging these patterns, such as detecting anomalies where Nouns rely heavily on LayerNorm, TPA effectively identifies hallucinated responses. Extensive experiments show that TPA achieves state-of-the-art performance.

title: Belief Is All You Need: Modeling Narrative Archetypes in Conspiratorial Discourse
summary:
Conspiratorial discourse is increasingly embedded within digital communication ecosystems, yet its structure and spread remain difficult to study. This work analyzes conspiratorial narratives in Singapore-based Telegram groups, showing that such content is woven into everyday discussions rather than confined to isolated echo chambers. We propose a two-stage computational framework. First, we fine-tune RoBERTa-large to classify messages as conspiratorial or not, achieving an F1-score of 0.866 on 2,000 expert-labeled messages. Second, we build a signed belief graph in which nodes represent messages and edge signs reflect alignment in belief labels, weighted by textual similarity. We introduce a Signed Belief Graph Neural Network (SiBeGNN) that uses a Sign Disentanglement Loss to learn embeddings that separate ideological alignment from stylistic features.
  Using hierarchical clustering on these embeddings, we identify seven narrative archetypes across 553,648 messages: legal topics, medical concerns, media discussions, finance, contradictions in authority, group moderation, and general chat. SiBeGNN yields stronger clustering quality (cDBI = 8.38) than baseline methods (13.60 to 67.27), supported by 88 percent inter-rater agreement in expert evaluations. Our analysis shows that conspiratorial messages appear not only in clusters focused on skepticism or distrust, but also within routine discussions of finance, law, and everyday matters. These findings challenge common assumptions about online radicalization by demonstrating that conspiratorial discourse operates within ordinary social interaction. The proposed framework advances computational methods for belief-driven discourse analysis and offers applications for stance detection, political communication studies, and content moderation policy.

title: Renormalizable Spectral-Shell Dynamics as the Origin of Neural Scaling Laws
summary:
Neural scaling laws and double-descent phenomena suggest that deep-network training obeys a simple macroscopic structure despite highly nonlinear optimization dynamics. We derive such structure directly from gradient descent in function space. For mean-squared error loss, the training error evolves as $\dot e_t=-M(t)e_t$ with $M(t)=J_{θ(t)}J_{θ(t)}^{\!*}$, a time-dependent self-adjoint operator induced by the network Jacobian. Using Kato perturbation theory, we obtain an exact system of coupled modewise ODEs in the instantaneous eigenbasis of $M(t)$.
  To extract macroscopic behavior, we introduce a logarithmic spectral-shell coarse-graining and track quadratic error energy across shells. Microscopic interactions within each shell cancel identically at the energy level, so shell energies evolve only through dissipation and external inter-shell interactions. We formalize this via a \emph{renormalizable shell-dynamics} assumption, under which cumulative microscopic effects reduce to a controlled net flux across shell boundaries.
  Assuming an effective power-law spectral transport in a relevant resolution range, the shell dynamics admits a self-similar solution with a moving resolution frontier and explicit scaling exponents. This framework explains neural scaling laws and double descent, and unifies lazy (NTK-like) training and feature learning as two limits of the same spectral-shell dynamics.

title: Structural Methods for handling mode changes in multimode DAE systems
summary: Hybrid systems are an important concept in Cyber-Physical Systems modeling, for which multiphysics modeling from first principles and the reuse of models from libraries are key. To achieve this, DAEs must be used to specify the dynamics in each discrete state (or mode in our context). This led to the development of DAE-based equational languages supporting multiple modes, of which Modelica is a popular standard. Mode switching can be time- or state-based. Impulsive behaviors can occur at mode changes. While mode changes are well understood in particular physics (e.g., contact mechanics), this is not the case in physics-agnostic paradigms such as Modelica. This situation causes difficulties for the compilation of programs, often requiring users to manually smooth out mode changes. In this paper, we propose a novel approach for the hot restart at mode changes in such paradigms. We propose a mathematical meaning for hot restarts (such a mathematical meaning does not exist in general), as well as a combined structural and impulse analysis for mode changes, generating the hot restart even in the presence of impulses. Our algorithm detects at compile time if the mode change is insufficiently specified, in which case it returns diagnostics information to the user.

title: Minimal Clips, Maximum Salience: Long Video Summarization via Key Moment Extraction
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are able to process increasingly longer videos. Yet, important visual information is easily lost throughout the entire context and missed by VLMs. Also, it is important to design tools that enable cost-effective analysis of lengthy video content. In this paper, we propose a clip selection method that targets key video moments to be included in a multimodal summary. We divide the video into short clips and generate compact visual descriptions of each using a lightweight video captioning model. These are then passed to a large language model (LLM), which selects the K clips containing the most relevant visual information for a multimodal summary. We evaluate our approach on reference clips for the task, automatically derived from full human-annotated screenplays and summaries in the MovieSum dataset. We further show that these reference clips (less than 6% of the movie) are sufficient to build a complete multimodal summary of the movies in MovieSum. Using our clip selection method, we achieve a summarization performance close to that of these reference clips while capturing substantially more relevant video information than random clip selection. Importantly, we maintain low computational cost by relying on a lightweight captioning model.

title: Toward P vs NP: An Observer-Theoretic Separation via SPDP Rank and a ZFC-Equivalent Foundation within the N-Frame Model
summary:
We present a self-contained separation framework for P vs NP developed entirely within ZFC. The approach consists of: (i) a deterministic, radius-1 compilation from uniform polynomial-time Turing computation to local sum-of-squares (SoS) polynomials with polylogarithmic contextual entanglement width (CEW); (ii) a formal Width-to-Rank upper bound for the resulting SPDP matrices at matching parameters; (iii) an NP-side identity-minor lower bound in the same encoding; and (iv) a rank-monotone, instance-uniform extraction map from the compiled P-side polynomials to the NP family. Together these yield a contradiction under the assumption P = NP, establishing a separation.
  We develop a correspondence between CEW, viewed as a quantitative measure of computational contextuality, and SPDP rank, yielding a unified criterion for complexity separation. We prove that bounded-CEW observers correspond to polynomial-rank computations (the class P), while unbounded CEW characterizes the class NP. This implies that exponential SPDP rank for #3SAT and related hard families forces P != NP within the standard framework of complexity theory.
  Key technical components include: (1) constructive lower bounds on SPDP rank via Ramanujan-Tseitin expander families; (2) a non-circular reduction from Turing-machine computation to low-rank polynomial evaluation; (3) a codimension-collapse lemma ensuring that rank amplification cannot occur within polynomial resources; and (4) proofs of barrier immunity against relativization, natural proofs, and algebrization. The result is a complete ZFC proof architecture whose primitives and compositions are fully derived, with community verification and machine-checked formalization left as future work.

title: Tiny Recursive Models on ARC-AGI-1: Inductive Biases, Identity Conditioning, and Test-Time Compute
summary: Tiny Recursive Models (TRM) were proposed as a parameter-efficient alternative to large language models for solving Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) style tasks. The original work reports strong performance and suggests that recursive latent updates enable non-trivial reasoning, but it remains unclear how much of this performance stems from architecture, test-time compute, or task-specific priors. In this technical note, we empirically analyze the ARC Prize TRM checkpoint on ARC-AGI-1 and report four behavioral findings and an efficiency comparison. First, we show that test-time augmentation and majority-vote ensembling account for a substantial fraction of reported performance: the 1000-sample voting pipeline improves Pass@1 by about 11 percentage points over single-pass canonical inference. Second, a puzzle-identity ablation reveals strict dependence on task identifiers: replacing the correct puzzle ID with a blank or random token yields zero accuracy. Third, a recursion trajectory analysis shows that most of the final accuracy is achieved at the first recursion step and that performance saturates after few latent updates, indicating shallow effective recursion. Fourth, early-stage training experiments under canonical versus heavy augmentation regimes suggest that heavy augmentation broadens the distribution of candidate solutions and improves multi-sample success. Finally, we compare TRM with a naive QLoRA fine-tune of Llama 3 8B on canonical ARC-AGI-1, finding that TRM's non-autoregressive design achieves much higher throughput and substantially lower memory usage in this setting. Overall, TRM's ARC-AGI-1 performance appears to arise from an interaction between efficiency, task-specific conditioning, and aggressive test-time compute rather than deep internal reasoning.

title: Modular and Multi-Path-Aware Offline Benchmarking for Mobile GUI Agents
summary: Mobile GUI Agents, AI agents capable of interacting with mobile applications on behalf of users, have the potential to transform human computer interaction. However, current evaluation practices for GUI agents face two fundamental limitations. First, they either rely on single path offline benchmarks or online live benchmarks. Offline benchmarks using static, single path annotated datasets unfairly penalize valid alternative actions, while online benchmarks suffer from poor scalability and reproducibility due to the dynamic and unpredictable nature of live evaluation. Second, existing benchmarks treat agents as monolithic black boxes, overlooking the contributions of individual components, which often leads to unfair comparisons or obscures key performance bottlenecks. To address these limitations, we present MobiBench, the first modular and multi path aware offline benchmarking framework for mobile GUI agents that enables high fidelity, scalable, and reproducible evaluation entirely in offline settings. Our experiments demonstrate that MobiBench achieves 94.72 percent agreement with human evaluators, on par with carefully engineered online benchmarks, while preserving the scalability and reproducibility of static offline benchmarks. Furthermore, our comprehensive module level analysis uncovers several key insights, including a systematic evaluation of diverse techniques used in mobile GUI agents, optimal module configurations across model scales, the inherent limitations of current LFMs, and actionable guidelines for designing more capable and cost efficient mobile agents.

title: NL2Repo-Bench: Towards Long-Horizon Repository Generation Evaluation of Coding Agents
summary: Recent advances in coding agents suggest rapid progress toward autonomous software development, yet existing benchmarks fail to rigorously evaluate the long-horizon capabilities required to build complete software systems. Most prior evaluations focus on localized code generation, scaffolded completion, or short-term repair tasks, leaving open the question of whether agents can sustain coherent reasoning, planning, and execution over the extended horizons demanded by real-world repository construction. To address this gap, we present NL2Repo Bench, a benchmark explicitly designed to evaluate the long-horizon repository generation ability of coding agents. Given only a single natural-language requirements document and an empty workspace, agents must autonomously design the architecture, manage dependencies, implement multi-module logic, and produce a fully installable Python library. Our experiments across state-of-the-art open- and closed-source models reveal that long-horizon repository generation remains largely unsolved: even the strongest agents achieve below 40% average test pass rates and rarely complete an entire repository correctly. Detailed analysis uncovers fundamental long-horizon failure modes, including premature termination, loss of global coherence, fragile cross-file dependencies, and inadequate planning over hundreds of interaction steps. NL2Repo Bench establishes a rigorous, verifiable testbed for measuring sustained agentic competence and highlights long-horizon reasoning as a central bottleneck for the next generation of autonomous coding agents.

title: Comparative Analysis of LLM Abliteration Methods: A Cross-Architecture Evaluation
summary: Safety alignment mechanisms in large language models prevent responses to harmful queries through learned refusal behavior, yet these same mechanisms impede legitimate research applications including cognitive modeling, adversarial testing, and security analysis. While abliteration techniques enable surgical removal of refusal representations through directional orthogonalization, the relative effectiveness of available implementations remains uncharacterized. This study evaluates four abliteration tools (Heretic, DECCP, ErisForge, FailSpy) across sixteen instruction-tuned models (7B-14B parameters), reporting tool compatibility on all 16 models and quantitative metrics on subsets dictated by tool support. Single-pass methods demonstrated superior capability preservation on the benchmarked subset (avg GSM8K change across three models: ErisForge -0.28 pp; DECCP -0.13 pp), while Bayesian-optimized abliteration produced variable distribution shift (KL divergence: 0.043-1.646) with model-dependent capability impact. These findings provide researchers with evidence-based selection criteria for abliteration tool deployment across diverse model architectures. The principal finding indicates that mathematical reasoning capabilities exhibit the highest sensitivity to abliteration interventions, with GSM8K change ranging from +1.51 pp to -18.81 pp (-26.5% relative) depending on tool selection and model architecture.

title: LLM4Perf: Large Language Models Are Effective Samplers for Multi-Objective Performance Modeling
summary: The performance of modern software systems is critically dependent on their complex configuration options. Building accurate performance models to navigate this vast space requires effective sampling strategies, yet existing methods often struggle with multi-objective optimization and cannot leverage semantic information from documentation. The recent success of Large Language Models (LLMs) motivates the central question of this work: Can LLMs serve as effective samplers for multi-objective performance modeling? To explore this, we present a comprehensive empirical study investigating the capabilities and characteristics of LLM-driven sampling. We design and implement LLM4Perf, a feedback-based framework, and use it to systematically evaluate the LLM-guided sampling process across four highly configurable, real-world systems. Our study reveals that the LLM-guided approach outperforms traditional baselines in most cases. Quantitatively, LLM4Perf achieves the best performance in nearly 68.8% (77 out of 112) of all evaluation scenarios, demonstrating its superior effectiveness. We find this effectiveness stems from the LLM's dual capabilities of configuration space pruning and feedback-driven strategy refinement. The effectiveness of this pruning is further validated by the fact that it also improves the performance of the baseline methods in nearly 91.5% (410 out of 448) of cases. Furthermore, we show how the LLM choices for each component and hyperparameters within LLM4Perf affect its effectiveness. Overall, this paper provides strong evidence for the effectiveness of LLMs in performance engineering and offers concrete insights into the mechanisms that drive their success.

AI.title_translation: LLM4Perf：大型语言模型是多目标性能建模的有效采样器
AI.tldr: LLM4Perf是一个基于反馈的框架，使用大型语言模型（LLM）作为采样器，用于多目标性能建模。它通过配置空间剪枝和反馈驱动的策略优化，在四种真实世界的系统中，其性能明显优于传统基线（在68.8%的场景中表现最佳）。
AI.motivation: 现代软件系统的性能严重依赖于复杂的配置选项。构建准确的性能模型需要有效的采样策略，但现有方法难以处理多目标优化，并且无法利用文档中的语义信息。
AI.method: 提出并实现了一个名为LLM4Perf的基于反馈的框架，用于系统地评估LLM驱动的采样过程。通过对四种高度可配置的真实世界系统进行全面的实证研究来验证其能力和特性。
AI.result: LLM4Perf在大多数情况下优于传统基线，在所有评估场景中，有近68.8%（112个中的77个）实现了最佳性能。其有效性源于LLM配置空间剪枝和反馈驱动策略优化的双重能力。剪枝功能还将基线方法的性能提高了近91.5%（448个中的410个）。
AI.conclusion: 本文为大型语言模型在性能工程中的有效性提供了强有力的证据，并具体阐述了驱动其成功的机制。
AI.translation: 现代软件系统的性能关键地依赖于其复杂的配置选项。构建准确的性能模型以驾驭这一广阔空间需要有效的采样策略，然而现有方法通常难以应对多目标优化，并且无法利用文档中的语义信息。大型语言模型（LLMs）最近的成功激发了这项工作的核心问题：LLMs能否作为多目标性能建模的有效采样器？为了探索这一点，我们进行了一项全面的实证研究，调查了LLM驱动采样的能力和特点。我们设计并实现了LLM4Perf，一个基于反馈的框架，并用它来系统地评估LLM引导的采样过程，涉及四个高度可配置的真实世界系统。我们的研究显示，LLM引导的方法在大多数情况下优于传统基线。定量来看，LLM4Perf在近68.8%（112个中的77个）的所有评估场景中实现了最佳性能，展示了其卓越的有效性。我们发现这种有效性源于LLM配置空间剪枝和反馈驱动策略优化的双重能力。剪枝的有效性通过以下事实得到了进一步验证：它还将基线方法的性能提高了近91.5%（448个中的410个）。此外，我们展示了LLM4Perf中LLM对每个组件的选择和超参数如何影响其有效性。总而言之，本文为LLMs在性能工程中的有效性提供了强有力的证据，并对驱动其成功的机制提供了具体的见解。
AI.summary: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLMs）作为多目标性能建模的有效采样器的潜力。作者提出了一个名为LLM4Perf的基于反馈的框架，并在四个高度可配置的真实系统上进行了实证评估。结果表明，LLM4Perf在超过三分之二的测试场景中优于传统采样基线。这种优越性归因于LLM能够进行配置空间剪枝和基于反馈的策略优化。研究证实了LLMs在性能工程中的强大作用。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型（LLM）, 性能建模, 多目标优化, 采样策略, 配置空间剪枝
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新点在于将大型语言模型（LLM）的语义理解能力和推理能力应用于传统的性能工程领域中的关键挑战——高效采样。通过设计一个名为LLM4Perf的反馈框架，作者有效地解决了现有采样策略在多目标优化和利用配置文档语义信息方面的不足。68.8%的最佳性能和对基线方法高达91.5%的改进，提供了强有力的数据支持，证明了LLM作为智能采样器的巨大潜力，为软件系统配置优化开辟了新的研究方向。

title: CALM: A CKA-Guided Adaptive Layer-Wise Modularization Framework for LLM Quantization
summary: Current mainstream post-training quantization methods for large language models typically apply a uniform quantization strategy across all network layers, overlooking the substantial differences in algorithmic suitability among layers. To address this limitation, we propose CALM (A CKA-guided Adaptive Layer-wise Modularization)a fine-tuning-free, plug-and-play framework for algorithmic heterogeneous quantization. CALM independently evaluates multiple PTQ algorithms on each layer and employs Linear Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) as a metric to automatically select the optimal quantization strategy per layer. The individually optimized strategies are then integrated to construct a hybrid quantized model. Experiments demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms both uniform quantization baselines and state-of-the-art mixed-precision methods across mainstream LLMsincluding LLaMA and Qwenin terms of perplexity (PPL) and downstream task performance.

AI.title_translation: CALM：一个CKA引导的LLM量化的自适应层级模块化框架
AI.tldr: CALM是一个新的、无需微调的框架，它使用CKA指标为LLM的每一层选择最佳的量化算法，从而实现异构量化，显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 当前主流的大型语言模型后训练量化（PTQ）方法通常在所有网络层应用统一的量化策略，忽略了不同层之间算法适用性的巨大差异。
AI.method: 提出CALM（CKA引导的自适应层级模块化），这是一个无需微调、即插即用的算法异构量化框架。该方法独立评估每层上的多个后训练量化（PTQ）算法，并使用线性中心核对齐（CKA）作为指标，自动为每层选择最佳量化策略。随后将这些单独优化的策略集成起来，构建一个混合量化模型。
AI.result: CALM在主流LLM（包括LLaMA和Qwen）上，在困惑度（PPL）和下游任务性能方面，持续优于统一量化基线和最先进的混合精度方法。
AI.translation: 当前主流的大型语言模型后训练量化方法通常在所有网络层应用统一的量化策略，忽略了各层之间算法适用性的巨大差异。为解决这一限制，我们提出了CALM（CKA引导的自适应层级模块化），这是一个无需微调、即插即用的算法异构量化框架。CALM独立评估每层上的多个PTQ算法，并采用线性中心核对齐（CKA）作为指标，自动为每层选择最佳量化策略。然后将单独优化的策略集成起来构建一个混合量化模型。实验证明，我们的方法在主流LLM（包括LLaMA和Qwen）上，在困惑度（PPL）和下游任务性能方面，持续优于统一量化基线和最先进的混合精度方法。
AI.summary: CALM是一个无需微调、即插即用的框架，旨在解决LLM量化中统一策略忽略层间差异的问题。该框架通过使用线性中心核对齐（CKA）指标，为模型的每一层自适应地选择最优的后训练量化（PTQ）算法，从而构建一个性能更优的混合量化模型。实验结果显示，CALM在多个主流LLM上，相比于统一量化和现有混合精度方法，在PPL和下游任务表现上都有显著提升。
AI.keywords: LLM量化, 异构量化, CKA, 自适应层级, 后训练量化
AI.comments: CALM的创新点在于引入了层级的“模块化”和“自适应”选择机制，打破了传统LLM量化中僵化的统一策略。使用线性中心核对齐（CKA）作为衡量算法适用性的指标是关键创新，它提供了一种数学上合理且无需微调的方式来评估不同量化策略对层级表示的影响。这对于提高量化效率和模型保真度具有重要意义，尤其是在追求更高压缩率和更低性能损失的背景下。

title: Robust Scene Coordinate Regression via Geometrically-Consistent Global Descriptors
comments: Accepted at IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2026
summary: Recent learning-based visual localization methods use global descriptors to disambiguate visually similar places, but existing approaches often derive these descriptors from geometric cues alone (e.g., covisibility graphs), limiting their discriminative power and reducing robustness in the presence of noisy geometric constraints. We propose an aggregator module that learns global descriptors consistent with both geometrical structure and visual similarity, ensuring that images are close in descriptor space only when they are visually similar and spatially connected. This corrects erroneous associations caused by unreliable overlap scores. Using a batch-mining strategy based solely on the overlap scores and a modified contrastive loss, our method trains without manual place labels and generalizes across diverse environments. Experiments on challenging benchmarks show substantial localization gains in large-scale environments while preserving computational and memory efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/sontung/robust_scr.
comment: Accepted at IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2026

AI.title_translation: 通过几何一致的全局描述符实现鲁棒的场景坐标回归
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种聚合器模块，通过结合几何结构和视觉相似性学习全局描述符，显著提高了大规模环境下视觉定位的鲁棒性和准确性，同时保持了计算和内存效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于学习的视觉定位方法通常仅从几何线索（如共视性图）中提取全局描述符，这限制了它们的判别能力，并在存在噪声几何约束时降低了鲁棒性。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种聚合器模块，该模块学习与几何结构和视觉相似性都一致的全局描述符，确保图像仅在视觉相似和空间连接时才在描述符空间中接近。它还利用基于重叠分数和改进对比损失的批次挖掘策略进行训练，无需手动地点标签，并能泛化到不同环境。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的基准测试中，该方法在大规模环境中显示出显著的定位增益，同时保持了计算和内存效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习结合几何结构和视觉相似性的全局描述符，本文提出的方法显著提高了大规模环境下的视觉定位性能和鲁棒性，同时保持了高效率。
AI.translation: 最近基于学习的视觉定位方法使用全局描述符来区分视觉上相似的地点，但现有方法通常仅从几何线索（例如共视性图）中推导出这些描述符，这限制了它们的判别能力并降低了在存在噪声几何约束时的鲁棒性。我们提出了一种聚合器模块，它学习与几何结构和视觉相似性都一致的全局描述符，确保图像仅在视觉相似和空间连接时才在描述符空间中接近。这纠正了由不可靠的重叠分数引起的错误关联。通过仅基于重叠分数的批次挖掘策略和改进的对比损失，我们的方法无需手动地点标签即可进行训练，并能泛化到不同的环境。在具有挑战性的基准测试中进行的实验表明，在大规模环境中实现了显著的定位增益，同时保持了计算和内存效率。代码可在 https://github.com/sontung/robust_scr 获取。
AI.summary: 该论文介绍了一种新的聚合器模块，用于学习几何一致的全局描述符，以改进基于学习的视觉定位。与现有方法不同，该模块整合了几何结构和视觉相似性，从而提高了描述符的判别力和在噪声环境中的鲁棒性。通过无监督的批次挖掘策略和改进的对比损失，该方法无需手动标签即可训练，并在大规模定位任务中表现出显著的性能提升和效率。
AI.keywords: 场景坐标回归, 全局描述符, 视觉定位, 几何一致性, 聚合器模块
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个聚合器模块，能同时学习结合几何结构和视觉相似性的全局描述符，有效地解决了现有方法在噪声几何约束下鲁判别力不足的问题。其无需手动标签的训练方式和在大规模环境下的高效表现，使其在实际应用中具有重要价值。

title: Timely Information Updating for Mobile Devices Without and With ML Advice
comments: 23 pages, journal version of arXiv:1901.03137, submitted for possible journal publication
summary: This paper investigates an information update system in which a mobile device monitors a physical process and sends status updates to an access point (AP). A fundamental trade-off arises between the timeliness of the information maintained at the AP and the update cost incurred at the device. To address this trade-off, we propose an online algorithm that determines when to transmit updates using only available observations. The proposed algorithm asymptotically achieves the optimal competitive ratio against an adversary that can simultaneously manipulate multiple sources of uncertainty, including the operation duration, information staleness, update cost, and update opportunities. Furthermore, by incorporating machine learning (ML) advice of unknown reliability into the design, we develop an ML-augmented algorithm that asymptotically attains the optimal consistency-robustness trade-off, even when the adversary can additionally corrupt the ML advice. The optimal competitive ratio scales linearly with the range of update costs, but is unaffected by other sources of uncertainty. Moreover, an optimal competitive online algorithm exhibits a threshold-like response to the ML advice: it either fully trusts or completely ignores the ML advice, as partially trusting the advice cannot improve the consistency without severely degrading the robustness. Extensive simulations in stochastic settings further validate the theoretical findings in the adversarial environment.
comment: 23 pages, journal version of arXiv:1901.03137, submitted for possible journal publication

AI.title_translation: 移动设备在有无机器学习建议下的及时信息更新
AI.tldr: 针对移动设备信息更新中时间性和成本的权衡，我们提出了一个在线算法，并进一步提出了一个结合不可靠ML建议的算法，两者在各自的设定下都实现了最优性能，且最优算法对ML建议只有“全信”或“全不信”两种处理方式。
AI.motivation: 移动设备监控物理过程并向接入点（AP）发送状态更新时，信息的时间性和更新成本之间存在根本性的权衡。需要一个算法来有效地管理这种权衡。
AI.method: 提出一个仅使用可用观测的在线算法来确定何时传输更新；进一步开发了一个结合不可靠的机器学习（ML）建议的ML增强算法。理论分析了在对抗性设置下，算法的竞争比和权衡性能。
AI.result: 提出的在线算法在对抗性环境中渐近地实现了最优竞争比；ML增强算法渐近地实现了最优的一致性-鲁棒性权衡；最优竞争比与更新成本范围成线性关系，但不受其他不确定性源的影响；最优在线算法对ML建议表现出阈值响应（完全信任或完全忽略）。
AI.conclusion: 研究人员提出了一个在线算法来解决信息更新的时间性和成本之间的权衡，并开发了一个结合不可靠机器学习建议的算法，两者在各自的设定下都实现了最优的竞争比和权衡。最优在线算法对机器学习建议表现出阈值响应特性。
AI.translation: 本文研究了一个信息更新系统，其中移动设备监控物理过程并向接入点（AP）发送状态更新。在信息保持在AP上的及时性与设备产生的更新成本之间存在根本性的权衡。为解决这种权衡，我们提出了一种在线算法，该算法仅使用可用观测来确定何时传输更新。所提出的算法在对抗性环境中，即对手可以同时操纵多种不确定性源（包括操作持续时间、信息陈旧性、更新成本和更新机会）时，渐近地实现了最优的竞争比。此外，通过将不可靠性的机器学习（ML）建议纳入设计，我们开发了一种ML增强算法，即使在对手可以额外破坏ML建议的情况下，也能渐近地实现最优的一致性-鲁棒性权衡。最优竞争比与更新成本的范围成线性关系，但不受其他不确定性源的影响。此外，最优在线算法对ML建议表现出一种阈值响应：它要么完全信任ML建议，要么完全忽略它，因为部分信任ML建议会在不严重损害鲁棒性的情况下提高一致性。随机环境下的广泛模拟进一步验证了对抗环境下的理论发现。
AI.summary: 本文研究了移动设备信息更新系统中时间性与更新成本之间的权衡问题。研究人员首先提出了一个仅依赖观测的在线算法，以渐近最优的竞争比解决了对抗性环境下的权衡问题。随后，通过整合不可靠的机器学习建议，设计了ML增强算法，实现了最优的一致性-鲁棒性权衡。研究发现，最优算法对ML建议呈阈值反应。随机环境下的模拟验证了理论结果。
AI.keywords: 信息更新, 时间性与成本权衡, 在线算法, 机器学习建议, 对抗性分析
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个在线算法来解决信息更新的时间性和成本之间的权衡问题，并且进一步扩展到结合不可靠的机器学习建议，实现了最优的权衡。其理论分析覆盖了多种不确定性源，具有较强的鲁棒性。局限性在于仅基于在线和对抗性模型，实际应用中的复杂性可能未完全覆盖。

title: ImagineNav++: Prompting Vision-Language Models as Embodied Navigator through Scene Imagination
comments: 17 pages, 10 figures. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2410.09874
summary: Visual navigation is a fundamental capability for autonomous home-assistance robots, enabling long-horizon tasks such as object search. While recent methods have leveraged Large Language Models (LLMs) to incorporate commonsense reasoning and improve exploration efficiency, their planning remains constrained by textual representations, which cannot adequately capture spatial occupancy or scene geometry--critical factors for navigation decisions. We explore whether Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can achieve mapless visual navigation using only onboard RGB/RGB-D streams, unlocking their potential for spatial perception and planning. We achieve this through an imagination-powered navigation framework, ImagineNav++, which imagines future observation images from candidate robot views and translates navigation planning into a simple best-view image selection problem for VLMs. First, a future-view imagination module distills human navigation preferences to generate semantically meaningful viewpoints with high exploration potential. These imagined views then serve as visual prompts for the VLM to identify the most informative viewpoint. To maintain spatial consistency, we develop a selective foveation memory mechanism, which hierarchically integrates keyframe observations via a sparse-to-dense framework, constructing a compact yet comprehensive memory for long-term spatial reasoning. This approach transforms goal-oriented navigation into a series of tractable point-goal navigation tasks. Extensive experiments on open-vocabulary object and instance navigation benchmarks show that ImagineNav++ achieves SOTA performance in mapless settings, even surpassing most map-based methods, highlighting the importance of scene imagination and memory in VLM-based spatial reasoning.

AI.title_translation: ImagineNav++：通过场景想象提示视觉-语言模型作为具身导航器
AI.tldr: ImagineNav++是一个无图视觉导航框架，它通过让视觉-语言模型（VLM）想象未来视图并选择最佳视图来进行规划。它使用分层记忆机制保持空间一致性，并在导航基准测试中达到了SOTA性能，甚至超越了基于地图的方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于大语言模型（LLM）的导航方法受限于文本表示，无法充分捕获对导航决策至关重要的空间占据和场景几何信息。本文旨在探索视觉-语言模型（VLM）是否仅使用板载RGB/RGB-D流就能实现无图视觉导航，从而释放其空间感知和规划的潜力。
AI.method: 提出ImagineNav++框架，通过场景想象实现导航。该方法将导航规划转化为VLM的最佳视图图像选择问题。首先，未来视图想象模块蒸馏人类导航偏好，生成具有高探索潜力的语义上有意义的视点。然后，这些想象的视图作为视觉提示供VLM选择最有效的视点。为保持空间一致性，开发了选择性中央凹记忆机制（通过稀疏到密集的框架），分层整合关键帧观察结果，用于长期空间推理，并将目标导向导航转化为一系列可处理的点目标导航任务。
AI.result: 在开放词汇对象和实例导航基准上，ImagineNav++在无图设置中实现了最先进（SOTA）的性能，甚至超越了大多数基于地图的方法。
AI.conclusion: 场景想象和记忆对于基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的空间推理在导航中至关重要。

AI.summary: ImagineNav++是一种新颖的无图视觉导航框架，它利用视觉-语言模型（VLM）进行空间规划。该框架通过未来视图想象模块生成候选视点，并将导航转化为VLM选择最佳视图的问题，从而克服了文本规划的空间限制。为了解决长期空间一致性问题，它引入了选择性中央凹记忆机制。实验证明，ImagineNav++在无图导航任务中达到了SOTA性能，甚至超越了许多基于地图的方法。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言模型, 具身导航, 场景想象, 无图导航, 空间推理
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了“场景想象”驱动的导航框架ImagineNav++，将复杂的空间规划问题转化为视觉-语言模型（VLM）的最佳视图选择问题，有效克服了现有基于文本的规划方法在空间几何捕获上的局限性。其重要性在于，该方法在仅依赖板载传感器的无图导航设置中实现了最先进（SOTA）的性能，甚至超越了多数基于地图的方法，有力证明了场景想象和分层记忆机制对于VLM进行具身空间推理的有效性和潜力。

title: Name That Part: 3D Part Segmentation and Naming
summary: We address semantic 3D part segmentation: decomposing objects into parts with meaningful names. While datasets exist with part annotations, their definitions are inconsistent across datasets, limiting robust training. Previous methods produce unlabeled decompositions or retrieve single parts without complete shape annotations. We propose ALIGN-Parts, which formulates part naming as a direct set alignment task. Our method decomposes shapes into partlets - implicit 3D part representations - matched to part descriptions via bipartite assignment. We combine geometric cues from 3D part fields, appearance cues from multi-view vision features, and semantic knowledge from language-model-generated affordance descriptions. Text-alignment loss ensures partlets share embedding space with text, enabling a theoretically open-vocabulary matching setup, given sufficient data. Our efficient and novel, one-shot, 3D part segmentation and naming method finds applications in several downstream tasks, including serving as a scalable annotation engine. As our model supports zero-shot matching to arbitrary descriptions and confidence-calibrated predictions for known categories, with human verification, we create a unified ontology that aligns PartNet, 3DCoMPaT++, and Find3D, consisting of 1,794 unique 3D parts. We introduce two novel metrics appropriate for the named 3D part segmentation task. We also show examples from our newly created TexParts dataset.

AI.title_translation: 命名部件：3D部件分割与命名
AI.tldr: 提出ALIGN-Parts，一种新颖的3D部件分割和命名方法，通过将部件命名公式化为直接集合对齐任务，解决了现有数据集不一致和之前方法局限性的问题，实现了开放词汇匹配和零样本能力。
AI.motivation: 现有3D部件分割数据集的定义不一致，限制了鲁棒训练。以往方法产生未标记的分解或只能检索单个部件，缺乏完整的形状注释。
AI.method: 提出ALIGN-Parts，将部件命名视为直接集合对齐任务。该方法将形状分解为隐式3D部件表示的“partlets”，通过二分匹配将其与部件描述对齐。结合了来自3D部件场的几何线索、多视图视觉特征的外观线索以及语言模型生成的“affordance”描述的语义知识。文本对齐损失确保partlets与文本共享嵌入空间，从而在数据充足的情况下实现理论上的开放词汇匹配设置。
AI.result: ALIGN-Parts是一种高效、新颖、一次性（one-shot）的3D部件分割和命名方法，可应用于多个下游任务，如可扩展的标注引擎。模型支持对任意描述进行零样本匹配，并为已知类别提供置信度校准的预测。通过人工验证，创建了一个统一的本体，对齐了PartNet、3DCoMPaT++和Find3D，包含1,794个独特的3D部件。引入了两个针对命名3D部件分割任务的新指标。还展示了新创建的TexParts数据集的示例。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出了一种新颖且高效的3D部件分割和命名方法ALIGN-Parts，通过集合对齐实现了开放词汇和零样本能力，解决了现有数据集不一致的问题，并创建了统一的部件本体和新数据集，为3D视觉任务提供了重要进展。
AI.translation: 我们研究语义3D部件分割：将对象分解为具有有意义名称的部件。尽管存在带有部件标注的数据集，但它们的定义在不同数据集之间不一致，限制了鲁棒训练。以前的方法产生未标记的分解或检索单个部件而没有完整的形状标注。我们提出了ALIGN-Parts，它将部件命名公式化为直接集合对齐任务。我们的方法将形状分解为partlets——隐式3D部件表示——通过二分匹配与部件描述进行匹配。我们结合了来自3D部件场的几何线索、来自多视图视觉特征的外观线索以及来自语言模型生成的“affordance”描述的语义知识。文本对齐损失确保partlets与文本共享嵌入空间，从而在数据充足的情况下实现理论上的开放词汇匹配设置。我们高效而新颖的一次性3D部件分割和命名方法在几个下游任务中找到了应用，包括作为可扩展的标注引擎。由于我们的模型支持对任意描述进行零样本匹配以及对已知类别的置信度校准预测，并经过人工验证，我们创建了一个统一的本体，对齐了PartNet、3DCoMPaT++和Find3D，包含1,794个独特的3D部件。我们引入了两个适用于命名3D部件分割任务的新指标。我们还展示了我们新创建的TexParts数据集的示例。
AI.summary: 本文提出ALIGN-Parts，一种解决语义3D部件分割和命名问题的新方法。针对现有数据集定义不一致和传统方法局限性，ALIGN-Parts将部件命名视为直接集合对齐任务。它将3D形状分解为隐式部件表示（partlets），并结合几何、外观和语义线索，通过文本对齐损失实现partlets与文本描述的开放词汇匹配。该方法具有零样本能力，可作为可扩展标注引擎，并构建了一个统一的3D部件本体（包含1,794个部件），同时引入了新指标和TexParts数据集。
AI.keywords: 3D部件分割, 部件命名, 集合对齐, 零样本, 开放词汇
AI.comments: ALIGN-Parts通过将3D部件分割和命名问题公式化为集合对齐任务，并利用多模态信息（几何、外观、语义语言模型），实现开放词汇和零样本能力，这是其主要创新点。该方法解决了现有数据集不一致的痛点，并提供了一个统一的部件本体，对3D视觉和下游任务具有重要意义。其作为可扩展标注引擎的潜力也值得关注。

title: NASTaR: NovaSAR Automated Ship Target Recognition Dataset
summary: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) offers a unique capability for all-weather, space-based maritime activity monitoring by capturing and imaging strong reflections from ships at sea. A well-defined challenge in this domain is ship type classification. Due to the high diversity and complexity of ship types, accurate recognition is difficult and typically requires specialized deep learning models. These models, however, depend on large, high-quality ground-truth datasets to achieve robust performance and generalization. Furthermore, the growing variety of SAR satellites operating at different frequencies and spatial resolutions has amplified the need for more annotated datasets to enhance model accuracy. To address this, we present the NovaSAR Automated Ship Target Recognition (NASTaR) dataset. This dataset comprises of 3415 ship patches extracted from NovaSAR S-band imagery, with labels matched to AIS data. It includes distinctive features such as 23 unique classes, inshore/offshore separation, and an auxiliary wake dataset for patches where ship wakes are visible. We validated the dataset applicability across prominent ship-type classification scenarios using benchmark deep learning models. Results demonstrate over 60% accuracy for classifying four major ship types, over 70% for a three-class scenario, more than 75% for distinguishing cargo from tanker ships, and over 87% for identifying fishing vessels. The NASTaR dataset is available at https://doi.org/10.5523/bris.2tfa6x37oerz2lyiw6hp47058, while relevant codes for benchmarking and analysis are available at https://github.com/benyaminhosseiny/nastar.

AI.title_translation: NASTaR：NovaSAR 自动化船舶目标识别数据集
AI.tldr: 本文介绍了NASTaR数据集，这是一个包含3415个船舶图像补丁的SAR数据集，用于解决船舶类型分类中高质量标注数据集的不足。该数据集包含23个独特类别，并已通过基准深度学习模型验证，在不同分类场景中取得了显著的准确率。
AI.motivation: 合成孔径雷达（SAR）在全天候海事活动监测中具有独特能力，但船舶类型分类面临挑战，需要专业的深度学习模型。这些模型依赖于大量高质量的地面实况数据集才能实现鲁棒性能和泛化。同时，不同频率和空间分辨率的SAR卫星种类日益增多，增加了对更多标注数据集的需求，以提高模型准确性。

AI.translation: 合成孔径雷达（SAR）通过捕获和成像海上船只的强反射，为全天候、天基海事活动监测提供了独特的能力。该领域的一个明确挑战是船舶类型分类。由于船舶类型的高度多样性和复杂性，准确识别十分困难，通常需要专门的深度学习模型。然而，这些模型依赖于大量、高质量的地面实况数据集才能实现鲁棒性能和泛化。此外，运行于不同频率和空间分辨率的SAR卫星种类日益增多，进一步加剧了对更多标注数据集的需求，以提高模型准确性。为解决此问题，我们提出了NovaSAR自动化船舶目标识别（NASTaR）数据集。该数据集包含从NovaSAR S波段图像中提取的3415个船舶补丁，其标签与AIS数据匹配。它包括23个独特的类别、近海/远海分离以及一个用于船舶尾迹可见补丁的辅助尾迹数据集等独特特征。我们使用基准深度学习模型，在主要船舶类型分类场景中验证了数据集的适用性。结果表明，对四种主要船舶类型的分类准确率超过60%，在三类场景中超过70%，区分货船和油轮的准确率超过75%，识别渔船的准确率超过87%。NASTaR数据集可在https://doi.org/10.5523/bris.2tfa6x37oerz2lyiw6hp47058获取，用于基准测试和分析的相关代码可在https://github.com/benyaminhosseiny/nastar获取。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了NASTaR数据集，这是一个专门为合成孔径雷达（SAR）船舶目标识别和类型分类设计的综合数据集。针对当前深度学习模型对高质量标注数据的高度依赖以及SAR卫星多样性带来的数据需求，NASTaR数据集包含了3415个从NovaSAR S波段图像中提取的船舶补丁，并与AIS数据匹配进行标签化。该数据集具有23个独特的船舶类别、近海/远海区分以及辅助尾迹信息。通过基准深度学习模型的验证，NASTaR数据集在多种船舶类型分类任务中展现出良好性能，例如对四种主要船舶类型分类准确率超过60%，对渔船识别准确率超过87%，为SAR海事监测领域的研究提供了宝贵的资源。

title: Measuring the Impact of Student Gaming Behaviors on Learner Modeling
summary: The expansion of large-scale online education platforms has made vast amounts of student interaction data available for knowledge tracing (KT). KT models estimate students' concept mastery from interaction data, but their performance is sensitive to input data quality. Gaming behaviors, such as excessive hint use, may misrepresent students' knowledge and undermine model reliability. However, systematic investigations of how different types of gaming behaviors affect KT remain scarce, and existing studies rely on costly manual analysis that does not capture behavioral diversity. In this study, we conceptualize gaming behaviors as a form of data poisoning, defined as the deliberate submission of incorrect or misleading interaction data to corrupt a model's learning process. We design Data Poisoning Attacks (DPAs) to simulate diverse gaming patterns and systematically evaluate their impact on KT model performance. Moreover, drawing on advances in DPA detection, we explore unsupervised approaches to enhance the generalizability of gaming behavior detection. We find that KT models' performance tends to decrease especially in response to random guess behaviors. Our findings provide insights into the vulnerabilities of KT models and highlight the potential of adversarial methods for improving the robustness of learning analytics systems.

AI.title_translation: 衡量学生游戏行为对学习者建模的影响
AI.tldr: 本研究通过数据投毒攻击模拟学生游戏行为，系统评估其对知识追踪模型性能的影响，并探索无监督检测方法，发现随机猜测行为对模型性能影响最大，揭示了KT模型的脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 大规模在线教育平台产生大量学生交互数据用于知识追踪（KT）模型，但学生的游戏行为（如过度使用提示）可能错误地代表学生知识，损害模型可靠性。现有研究对不同类型游戏行为如何影响KT的系统性调查不足，且依赖昂贵的手动分析，未能捕捉行为多样性。
AI.method: 本研究将游戏行为概念化为一种数据投毒形式，即故意提交不正确或误导性交互数据以破坏模型学习过程。研究设计了数据投毒攻击（DPAs）来模拟多样化的游戏模式，并系统评估其对KT模型性能的影响。此外，还探索了无监督方法以增强游戏行为检测的通用性。
AI.result: 研究发现，知识追踪（KT）模型的性能会下降，尤其是在面对随机猜测行为时下降最为明显。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果揭示了知识追踪（KT）模型的脆弱性，并强调了对抗性方法在提高学习分析系统鲁棒性方面的潜力。
AI.translation: 大规模在线教育平台的扩展使得大量的学生交互数据可用于知识追踪（KT）。KT模型根据交互数据估计学生的知识掌握程度，但其性能对输入数据质量敏感。游戏行为，例如过度使用提示，可能会错误地代表学生的知识并损害模型的可靠性。然而，关于不同类型的游戏行为如何影响KT的系统性研究仍然稀缺，并且现有研究依赖于昂贵的手动分析，未能捕捉行为多样性。在本研究中，我们将游戏行为概念化为一种数据投毒形式，定义为故意提交不正确或误导性的交互数据以破坏模型的学习过程。我们设计了数据投毒攻击（DPA）来模拟多样化的游戏模式，并系统地评估它们对KT模型性能的影响。此外，借鉴DPA检测的进展，我们探索了无监督方法以增强游戏行为检测的通用性。我们发现KT模型的性能往往会下降，尤其是在随机猜测行为时下降更为明显。我们的发现为KT模型的脆弱性提供了见解，并强调了对抗性方法在提高学习分析系统鲁棒性方面的潜力。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在系统评估学生游戏行为对知识追踪（KT）模型性能的影响。研究将游戏行为定义为数据投毒，并设计了数据投毒攻击（DPAs）来模拟多样化的游戏模式。通过实验，发现KT模型性能在随机猜测行为下显著下降。此外，研究还探索了无监督方法来增强游戏行为检测的通用性，为提高学习分析系统的鲁棒性提供了新的视角。
AI.keywords: 知识追踪, 学生游戏行为, 数据投毒, 学习分析, 模型鲁棒性
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将学生游戏行为概念化为数据投毒，并利用数据投毒攻击（DPAs）来模拟和系统评估其对知识追踪模型的影响，这提供了一种新颖且可控的研究方法。此外，探索无监督检测方法以提高泛化性也具有重要意义。研究结果揭示了KT模型在面对特定游戏行为时的脆弱性，对于在线学习系统的数据质量控制和模型鲁棒性提升具有实际指导价值。

title: Extended OpenTT Games Dataset: A table tennis dataset for fine-grained shot type and point outcome
comments: Thomas Martini Jørgensen and Emil Hovad contributed equally and share last authorship
summary: Automatically detecting and classifying strokes in table tennis video can streamline training workflows, enrich broadcast overlays, and enable fine-grained performance analytics. For this to be possible, annotated video data of table tennis is needed. We extend the public OpenTTGames dataset with highly detailed, frame-accurate shot type annotations (forehand, backhand with subtypes), player posture labels (body lean and leg stance), and rally outcome tags at point end. OpenTTGames is a set of recordings from the side of the table with official labels for bounces, when the ball is above the net, or hitting the net. The dataset already contains ball coordinates near events, which are either "bounce", "net", or "empty_event" in the original OpenTTGames dataset, and semantic masks (humans, table, scoreboard). Our extension adds the types of stroke to the events and a per-player taxonomy so models can move beyond event spotting toward tactical understanding (e.g., whether a stroke is likely to win the point or set up an advantage). We provide a compact coding scheme and code-assisted labeling procedure to support reproducible annotations and baselines for fine-grained stroke understanding in racket sports. This fills a practical gap in the community, where many prior video resources are either not publicly released or carry restrictive/unclear licenses that hinder reuse and benchmarking. Our annotations are released under the same CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license as OpenTTGames, allowing free non-commercial use, modification, and redistribution, with appropriate attribution.
comment: Thomas Martini Jørgensen and Emil Hovad contributed equally and share last authorship

AI.title_translation: 扩展OpenTT Games数据集：一个用于细粒度击球类型和得分结果的乒乓球数据集
AI.tldr: 该论文扩展了OpenTTGames数据集，增加了细粒度的击球类型、球员姿势标签和回合结果，以支持乒乓球视频中更高级的战术理解和性能分析，并解决了现有数据集的可用性问题。
AI.motivation: 为了简化训练流程、丰富广播叠加信息并实现细粒度的性能分析，需要有带注释的乒乓球视频数据来自动检测和分类乒乓球视频中的击球动作。
AI.method: 通过扩展现有的OpenTTGames数据集，增加了高度详细、帧精确的击球类型注释（正手、反手及子类型）、球员姿势标签（身体倾斜和腿部姿态）以及回合结束时的得分结果标签。他们还提供了一个紧凑的编码方案和代码辅助的标注程序。
AI.result: 提供了一个扩展的OpenTTGames数据集，其中包含新的细粒度击球类型、球员姿势和得分结果注释，允许模型从事件识别转向战术理解。该数据集在CC BY-NC-SA 4.0许可下发布，可免费用于非商业用途。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了社区中一个实际空白，即许多现有视频资源未公开或许可限制阻碍了重用和基准测试，从而支持了对球拍运动中细粒度击球的理解。
AI.translation: 自动检测和分类乒乓球视频中的击球动作可以简化训练流程、丰富广播叠加信息并实现细粒度的性能分析。为此，需要带注释的乒乓球视频数据。我们扩展了公开的OpenTTGames数据集，增加了高度详细、帧精确的击球类型注释（正手、反手及子类型）、球员姿势标签（身体倾斜和腿部姿态）以及回合结束时的得分结果标签。OpenTTGames是一组从球台侧面录制的视频，带有官方的弹跳、球在网上方或击中球网的标签。该数据集已经包含事件附近的球坐标，这些事件在原始OpenTTGames数据集中是“弹跳”、“球网”或“空事件”，以及语义掩码（人物、球台、记分牌）。我们的扩展为事件添加了击球类型和每个球员的分类，因此模型可以超越事件识别，转向战术理解（例如，击球是否可能赢得该分或建立优势）。我们提供了一个紧凑的编码方案和代码辅助的标注程序，以支持球拍运动中细粒度击球理解的可复现注释和基线。这填补了社区中的一个实际空白，即许多现有视频资源要么未公开，要么带有限制性/不明确的许可，阻碍了重用和基准测试。我们的注释与OpenTTGames在相同的CC BY-NC-SA 4.0许可下发布，允许在适当署名的情况下免费进行非商业使用、修改和再分发。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了扩展的OpenTTGames数据集，旨在通过添加细粒度的乒乓球击球类型（正手、反手）、球员姿势标签和回合结果注释，来增强乒乓球视频分析能力。该扩展允许AI模型从简单的事件识别提升到更深层次的战术理解。该数据集填补了现有资源不足的空白，并以开放许可发布，促进了社区内的研究和基准测试。
AI.keywords: 乒乓球数据集, 击球类型, 性能分析, OpenTTGames, 视频分析
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新之处在于它为乒乓球视频分析提供了前所未有的细粒度数据，特别是击球类型和球员姿势，这对于开发能够理解比赛战术和预测结果的AI模型至关重要。其重要性在于解决了现有数据集的局限性，通过提供开放且高质量的资源，极大地推动了体育分析领域的研究。该数据集的开放许可也确保了其广泛的应用和可复用性。

title: SiamGPT: Quality-First Fine-Tuning for Stable Thai Text Generation
summary: Open-weights large language models remain difficult to deploy for Thai due to unstable generation under complex instructions, despite strong English performance. To mitigate these limitations, We present SiamGPT-32B, an open-weights model based on Qwen3-32B, fine-tuned with a Quality-First strategy emphasizing curated supervision over data scale. The fine-tuning pipeline combines high-complexity English instruction data with a Thai-adapted AutoIF framework for instruction and linguistic constraints. Using supervised fine-tuning only, without continual pretraining or corpus expansion, SiamGPT-32B improves instruction adherence, multi-turn robustness, and linguistic stability. Evaluations on the SEA-HELM benchmark show that SiamGPT-32B achieves the strongest overall performance among similar-scale open-weights Thai models, with consistent gains in instruction following, multi-turn dialogue, and natural language understanding.

AI.title_translation: SiamGPT：面向质量优先的稳定泰语文本生成微调
